name: pricing-usage-slider
title: Pricing Usage Slider
description: A slider picks the number of seats and the monthly total ticks to match, with a summary panel beside it.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: basePrice
props.description: Flat monthly price that covers `included` units.

props.name: unitPrice
props.description: Monthly price of each unit above `included`.

props.name: action
props.type: { label: string; href?: string; onClick?: () => void }
props.description: Call to action under the total.

props.name: unit
props.description: Singular name of the counted unit.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial amount, clamped to min and max.

props.name: included
props.description: Units covered by the base price.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new amount while the slider moves.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
